description:
A lasting condition that hampers your effectiveness. When you suffer a Debility, mark it on your character sheet. Choose from
- Weakened
- Miserable
- Broken.
Your next roll gets a +1 bonus.
Cuts or bypasses thick armor and shielding. dmg of this type ignores armor and shield protection
Requires quick and careful aim to use well; Trade Blows+DEX (instead of +STR).
